quizName: Hardest Questions in Hawaii Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: When checking tire pressure, what should you do?

options.text: Look at the tire to judge its pressure.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.
Compare how tall the tire is to another tire.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check tire pressure before every ride. A tire that looks okay might actually be under-inflated, so looking at the tire is not enough.

questions.question: If your shoes have laces, what should you do with them?
questions.explanation: When riding, tuck your shoe laces in securely so they don't catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: What does wearing goggles protect?

options.text: Your face as well as a face shield does.
Your face the same way a windshield does.

questions.explanation: Goggles protect only your eyes, not the rest of your face. A face shield is better because it protects your whole face. A windshield does not provide enough protection by itself.

questions.question: How can you help other drivers see you on your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright clothing, always use your headlight, and use your turn signals.

questions.question: What should your lane position do?

options.text: Hide your riding plans from other drivers.
Invite other drivers to share your lane.
Help you see others and be seen by them.
Keep you close to road signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Help you see others and be seen by them.
questions.explanation: A good lane position helps you see others and be seen. It also helps you avoid wind blasts, other drivers' blind spots, and road hazards. It discourages other drivers from sharing your lane and gives you an escape route if danger appears.

questions.question: What should a motorcyclist scan the road ahead for?
questions.explanation: Scan ahead for traffic changes, road hazards, and escape routes. Be ready to react to any changes.

questions.question: What benefit can gloves provide?

options.text: They make the motorcycle harder to control and should be avoided.
They help other drivers see you.
They give you a better grip on the handlebars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They give you a better grip on the handlebars.
questions.explanation: Gloves give you a better grip on the handlebars. They also protect your hands if you crash.

questions.question: Which color is best to wear to be more visible?
questions.explanation: Orange, red, yellow, and green clothing make you easier to see. Wear bright colors any time you ride, day or night.

questions.question: How often should you check your mirrors?

options.text: As part of your regular scanning routine.
They don't help because you can't do anything about traffic behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: As part of your regular scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors frequently as part of your regular routine. Also check them before changing lanes, at intersections, and before slowing down.

questions.question: What certification should your helmet have for maximum protection?
questions.explanation: For maximum protection, wear a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. It only takes a few minutes and helps you stay safe before you start riding.

questions.question: Which surface gives a motorcycle the best traction?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces are slippery for motorcycles. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal plates are all dangerous. Dry pavement is the safest.

questions.question: Which item is not protective gear for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves. Sandals do not protect your feet.

questions.question: What material are motorcycle riding gloves usually made of?
questions.explanation: Riding gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while riding?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up

questions.explanation: Do not ride when tired. On long trips, take a rest break every two hours to avoid becoming too tired.

questions.question: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up and lean the motorcycle
Speed up and keep the motorcycle upright
Slow down and lean the motorcycle
Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright
questions.explanation: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, keep your motorcycle upright and go as slowly as possible.

questions.question: What best protects your head and neck in a crash?
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet is the best way to reduce head and neck injuries in a crash.

questions.question: What is true about clothing when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It should be loose enough to flap in the wind
It should not fully cover your arms and legs
You should not wear a jacket in warm weather
It can protect you in a crash

questions.correctAnswerText: It can protect you in a crash
questions.explanation: Good clothing provides protection in a crash. Wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly but not be so tight it limits your movement.

questions.question: What is true about a DOT-approved helmet?

options.text: It greatly reduces head injury severity
It makes it harder to control your motorcycle

questions.correctAnswerText: It greatly reduces head injury severity
questions.explanation: A DOT-approved helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. It will not limit your side vision or control.

questions.question: Which of these does not protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear a DOT helmet, eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high sturdy boots that cover your ankles, and durable gloves. A baseball cap does not provide real protection.

questions.question: What should you do about wearing riding gloves?

options.text: Do not wear them because they make your hands too hot.
Wear them to get a better grip on the handgrips.
Do not wear them because they make it harder to use the controls.
Wear them only on cold days.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear them to get a better grip on the handgrips.
questions.explanation: Wear leather gloves or gloves made of another strong material when riding. They give you a better grip on the handgrips and protect your hands if you crash.

questions.question: Which fabric protects motorcyclists the most?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the best protection for riders.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. A helmet is your best protection in a crash.

questions.question: What can remove alcohol from your body?
questions.explanation: Only time can lower your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot reduce your blood alcohol level or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they do not change how much alcohol is in your body.

questions.question: What is the most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet that is fastened securely is the single best thing you can do to improve your chances of surviving a crash.
